title: The Invoices import template keeps every other column and the column order
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin (all permissions, including Settings → Data Import) at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) on the What/Why QA build.
  • You can also sign in as an Admin to a build without this change (for example staging, while its Invoices import still lists "Line Title - What are you doing"), at {Location-B} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings and, under Data Import, click Invoices.
  2. Download the template (sample file).
  3. On the build without this change, open Settings, Data Import, Invoices and download its template.
  4. Open both files in a spreadsheet.
  5. Compare the two header rows column by column.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Steps 2 and 3: both templates download.
  • Step 5: both header rows have 24 columns. Every column has the same name in the same position except two: column 16 reads "*Line Title" (was "*Line Title - What are you doing") and column 17 reads "Line Description" (was "Line Description - Why are you doing it").

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11257; story SV-10133 (Story 4, The Imports); PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It (What/Why)", Confluence 845348896, version of 13 Oct 2026, S4-R7, read 13 Oct 2026; no design board exists for this story (tech plan: Story 2 and Story 4 are text-only), labels from the Jira story and tech plan; tech plan "Title and Description - Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 2026-09-23, shared by the QA lead 13 Oct 2026), FR-017 and Phase 4; Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (a What/Why QA build exists; verification by the build verification session).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R7: “Every other column name, and the required order of columns, is unchanged.”
  • SV-10133 acceptance criteria: “Given any import file, then every other column name and the required column order behaves exactly as before.”
  • Tech plan Phase 4: “Banner prose `:87-88` → `… Item, Line Title, Line Description, Tech Story, …`; template header `:249` → `…,*Item,*Line Title,Line Description,Tech Story,…`. Only those two tokens change; the other 22 columns and the order stay byte-identical”
